headlines.title: Adam Hamilton says 'sense of common decency' fueled his historic campaign victory
headlines.description: Sen.-elect Adam Hamilton (D-Kan.) joins Meet the Press to explain how he became the first Democrat elected to the senate in Kansas since 1932.

headlines.title: UFC’s Dana White says he will meet Trump on Monday to discuss press secretary offer
headlines.description: President Donald Trump said that he’d offered the job of White House press secretary to the CEO and president of the Ultimate Fighting Championship, Dana White.

headlines.title: 6 killed, 15 injured in shooting at main market square of Krakow, Poland
headlines.description: Authorities in Poland say they are investigating a shooting on Saturday that left six people dead and at least a 15 injured in the main market square in Krakow, a cultural center of the historic city. NBC News’ Daniele Hamamdjian reports.

headlines.title: James Talarico kicks off ‘SNL’ days after historic Texas Senate win
headlines.description: James Talarico, a Democrat whose U.S. Senate victory this week was once thought improbable in the Republican stronghold of Texas, made a surprise appearance to help kick off the latest episode of “Saturday Night Live.”

headlines.title: We want to hear your experience with changes to student loan repayment plans
headlines.description: If you’re a student borrower who was required to transition to another plan this year, share your story.

headlines.title: The human touch: Luxury brands embrace craftsmanship as ‘AI slop’ floods the internet
headlines.description: Artists say brands are embracing traditional art forms and making a point to show off the human labor behind their campaigns.

headlines.title: 2026 Rockefeller Center Christmas Tree Arrives in New York City
headlines.description: A magnificent Norway spruce has made its journey from West Edmeston, New York, to Rockefeller Center. The tree will undergo a glow-up ahead of the lighting ceremony on Dec. 2.

headlines.title: Democrats won big on Election Day. But can they agree on AI?
headlines.description: Democrats campaigned on concerns about AI and data centers, but competing priorities and opposition from the Trump administration could complicate efforts to enact new regulations.

headlines.title: 1 killed and 3 wounded in shootings on Winston-Salem State University campus
headlines.description: One person has died and three others were wounded after two separate shootings on Winston-Salem State University’s campus on Saturday.

headlines.title: Gov. Josh Shapiro urges Democrats to prioritize healthcare, food assistance
headlines.description: Pennsylvania Gov. Josh Shapiro said he hopes Democrats prioritize healthcare and food assistance when they take control of Congress in January, though he urged them not to forget to hold the Trump administration accountable.

headlines.title: Sen.-elect Adam Hamilton says he’d be disappointed if Democrats focus on investigating Trump
headlines.description: Sen.-elect Adam Hamilton said that he hopes to prioritize lowering costs and that he would be “deeply disappointed” to spend two years investigating Trump.

headlines.title: Kraków shooting that killed 6 was motivated by far-right views, authorities say
headlines.description: World leaders have paid tribute as Poland declared two national days of mourning after a shooter motivated by far-right ideologies killed six people in Kraków on Saturday, in what the country’s defense minister characterized as a “terror attack.”
